name: Random Language
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: TeaMaster
description: A fabric mod that randomizes the game's language.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Comma switches the game to a random language and says '[Random Language] Changing the language to: <language>' on the action bar; Period returns to the native language.
note: The language is the game's for the session; the options keep the player's own, as vanilla's.
